def equation(t, P, params):
    w = params[9]
    g = (params[0] + params[1]*t + params[2]*t**2 + params[3]*np.sin(w*t) + params[4]*np.cos(w*t)
         + params[5]*np.exp(-t) + params[6]*np.log(t) + params[7]*t*np.sin(w*t))
